verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no headless or CI mode for Canny: no CLI, no CI integration, and no service-token automation guidance. The MCP server is built for interactive LLM clients with sign-in ('No API keys'). The API reference appears only as a page title with no content, and a bare API is at most a developer building block, not a documented headless or CI capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
